entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Have you decided to tread the path of strife...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes... Come to me.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Very well. Let us proceed with our contract at once.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: I am thou, thou art I...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: You have finally found your own justice...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Please... Never lose sight of it again.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: This memorable day marks your graduation from your false self...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: What the hell!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A Persona...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: No, dude... That's a bike...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can feel it...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My "self"... Me...!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Gun it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wow... Nice!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wh-What is that!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I've never seen anything like it...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: You better earn your keep, or else I'll kill you!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I will not lose heart again, ever.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I will go full speed, nonstop!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Right, Johanna!?
